claim_boundary: These are operational instruments and instructions, not validation results. No reviewer, learner or listener judgment is included.

review_gates.purpose: Check heuristic speech-function labels in surrounding transcript context.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not have created the atlas, candidate labels or review queue.

review_gates.purpose: Check whether phrase-form hits support the proposed function family in context.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not have created the atlas, phrase queue or candidate labels.

review_gates.purpose: Check transcript alignment, speaker/setting observations, modality limits and safety boundaries.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not be the internal review author or packet creator.

review_gates.purpose: Review the five linked lesson packets and their evidence boundaries.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not be the packet creator or original interpreter.

learning_gates.purpose: Test whether learners can recognize, explain, transfer and safely bound all eight current draft communication patterns.
Test listener comprehension and immediate recall of matched speech versions, separately from learner teachability and from claims about trust, persuasion or behavior.

procedure: Use a reviewer code and record conflicts; do not use the original analyst for an independent judgment.
Inspect full surrounding context and source media where available; use indeterminate when evidence is insufficient.
Export the browser form without hand-editing judgment fields.
Run the named validator before returning the export.
Preserve disagreements; do not silently adjudicate them in the original analysis.
Do not send credentials, raw recordings or identifying participant information through these forms.
